newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-BUTCHER AND GALLIAN HIT 100S FOR ENGLAND A.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-BUTCHER AND GALLIAN HIT 100S FOR ENGLAND A.

text.p: England hopefuls Mark Butcher and Jason Gallian both struck centuries as England A reached 272 for two on the opening day of their four-day game against The Rest at Edgbaston on Friday.
The uncapped Butcher was 129 not out when bad light stopped play, having hit 16 fours and a six.
He put on 237 for the first wicket with Gallian who hit 18 fours in his 106.
Another man in good form was England discard Graeme Hick who smashed 178 from 124 balls in a 50-over friendly against Somerset at Taunton.
